hardware.note: Fuse holders: the CAD shows 5 bays; decision R13 asks for 6 holders in the cheap build (route B). Lever connectors: decision R14 asks for FOUR 5-way connectors; the CAD has two 40 x 17 x 17 bays, each can hold two side by side (check on the real parts).
hardware.screw_and_insert_counts: unchanged from docs/mechanical-design.md section 10 except: motherboard screws are M3 x 6 (insert hole 6 mm deep); optional bumper adds 2 micro switches and 4 small screws (2 per switch, pilot holes 1.8 mm); no new heat-set inserts were added by the CAD stages

insert_hole_helper_counts.note: counted by running the model with a counter in the two helper modules (copy of the files). Other holes (cover posts, board standoffs, caster, ...) are plain cylinders and are NOT in this count, so these two numbers do NOT add up to the 37 inserts of the doc.
